body:
For parents, grandparents, teachers, pastors, youth pastors, rabbis, imams, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and everyone else who wants to build a more peaceful, sustainable, regenerative world …

 Cory and the Seventh Story   is a resource for adults and kids to become more literate in the six stories that so frequently contribute to violence … and a seventh story that sows the seeds of peace.

 This all-ages picture book is available for pre-order now – for Christmas delivery. I co-wrote Cory with Irish peace-activist Gareth Higgins, and award-winning Heather Lynn Harris illustrated it with amazing artwork..

 You can also pre-order our companion e-book for adults, The Seventh Story: Us, Them, and the End of Violence.

 You can learn more here and order here.
